title: Atomistic Insights into the Stabilization of TDP-43 Protofibrils by ATP.
authors: Xu, Zhengdong; Tang, Jiaxing; Gong, Yehong; Zhang, Jianxin; Zou, Yu
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟研究ATP对TDP-43蛋白原纤维的稳定机制，虽涉及蛋白聚集与分子模拟，但对象为蛋白-配体（ATP）互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: The aberrant accumulation of the transactive response deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA)-binding protein of 43 kDa (TDP-43) aggregates in the cytoplasm of motor neurons is the main pathological hallmark of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Previous experiments reported that adenosine triphosphate (ATP), the universal energy currency for all living cells, could induce aggregation and enhance the folding of TDP-43 fibrillar aggregates. However, the significance of ATP on TDP-43 fibrillation and the mechanism behind it remain elusive. In this work, we conducted multiple atomistic molecular dynamics (MD) simulations totaling 20 mus to search the critical nucleus size of TDP-43(282-360) and investigate the impact of ATP molecules on preformed protofibrils. The results reveal that the trimer is the critical nucleus for TDP-43(282-360) fibril formation and the tetramer is the minimal stable nucleus. When ATP molecules bind to the TDP-43(282-360) trimer and tetramer, they can consolidate the TDP-43(282-360) protofibrils by increasing the content of the beta-sheet structure and promoting the formation of hydrogen bonds (H-bonds). Binding site analyses show that the N-terminus of TDP-43(282-360) protofibrils is the main binding site of ATP, and R293 dominates the direct binding of ATP. Further analyses reveal that the pi-pi, cation-pi, salt bridge, and H-bonding interactions together contribute to the binding of ATP to TDP-43(282-360) protofibrils. This study decoded the detailed stabilization mechanism of protofibrillar TDP-43(282-360) oligomers by ATP, and may provide new avenues for the development of drug design against ALS.
abstract_zh: 43 kDa反式激活反应脱氧核糖核酸（DNA）结合蛋白（TDP-43）在运动神经元细胞质中的异常聚集是肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的主要病理标志。既往实验报道，三磷酸腺苷（ATP）作为所有活细胞的通用能量货币，能够诱导TDP-43纤维状聚集体的聚集并增强其折叠。然而，ATP对TDP-43纤维化的意义及其背后的机制仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们进行了总时长为20微秒的多原子分子动力学（MD）模拟，以搜索TDP-43(282-360)的临界核大小，并探讨ATP分子对预形成原纤维的影响。结果表明，三聚体是TDP-43(282-360)纤维形成的关键核，而四聚体是最小的稳定核。当ATP分子与TDP-43(282-360)三聚体和四聚体结合时，它们通过增加β-折叠结构的含量并促进氢键（H-键）的形成，从而巩固TDP-43(282-360)原纤维。结合位点分析显示，TDP-43(282-360)原纤维的N端是ATP的主要结合位点，且R293主导ATP的直接结合。进一步分析揭示，π-π、阳离子-π、盐桥和H-键相互作用共同促进了ATP与TDP-43(282-360)原纤维的结合。本研究解析了ATP对原纤维状TDP-43(282-360)寡聚体的详细稳定机制，并可能为针对ALS的药物设计提供新途径。
